nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Integration documentation for the Meta Lead Ads CRM channel, describing how Meta lead-form submissions are automatically forwarded into the CRM, the leadgen webhook handled, the automatic customer/lead create-or-update actions, and the full settings reference (pipeline, stage, responsible user, field mappings, and Meta Page connection service fields).
nodes.languageNotes: Trilingual content (Russian/Uzbek/English) with an HTML-embedded full description and a settings reference table covering required, type, hide-in-UI, and placeholder columns.

nodes.name: ui_template.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the Meta Lead Ads Page connection UI, styling the panel, topbar, language switch, status badge, account row, action buttons, and onboarding steps across light/dark tone modes.

nodes.name: ui_template.html
nodes.summary: HTML template for the Meta Lead Ads Page connection/authorization screen, using server-side placeholder substitution (safe_lang, style_block, language_links, actions_html, steps_html, etc.) to render the connection status, account info, notices, and onboarding steps.
nodes.languageNotes: Static template driven by Python str.format-style placeholders (e.g. {safe_heading}, {language_links}) injected by the integration's connection flow.
